name: hud_ui_background_load_zrd_and_section
description: HudUiBackground::LoadZrdAndSection refreshes the primary surface, optionally captures it, resolves shared/config ZRD sections, loads configured images/videos/text/cursor/sounds, captures the composite background when requested, unlocks the primary surface state, and returns the loaded root node.
known_limits: The smoke covers the null-root path plus the unconditional video postprocess/unlock frame. Child image/video/cursor/text/sound loading is accepted compositionally from the direct dependency targets now marked functional-equivalent.
Reconstructed remains limited and tier S is deferred to a coherent HudUiBackground source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4b9900 validates the unconditional RunPostprocessOnPrimaryBuffer and Dispatch_UnlockPrimarySurfaceState calls, capturePrimary gate, root/cfgRoot handling, named ZRD node lookups, bounded loops for font/image/video/text/sound arrays, cursor setup, and child widget dispatches.

The native smoke verifies a null loaded root clears cfgRoot, returns null, and completes the postprocess/unlock frame with installed video surface providers. Direct dependency smokes cover the loaded child helper behavior.
